title: Alveolar Ridge Preservation Procedures Performed with a Freeze-Dried Bone Allograft: Clinical and Histologic Outcomes in a Case Series: Part II
authors: Barone, A., Cinquini, C., Valente, N. A., Velasco-Ortega, E., Derchi, G., D'Amico, E., & Iezzi, G. (2024). The International journal of periodontics & restorative dentistry, 0(0), 1–20.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxgraft granules (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The case series provides valuable insights into ARP performed with FDBA; implants were placed after 3 months of healing without any additional bone augmentation, the histologic outcomes were favorable, and implants were successful after a 2-year period of follow-up” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
